narrative.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Azure Silk Hood, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
narrative.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
narrative.offerRewardText: It da hood me order-er-ed! Me forgot why wanted in first place, but me take anyway. Here, take shiny coin. It fell out of slime monster. Lots and lots of them!
narrative.requestItemsText: AHHHH! Oh, it just a friend. Hi friend!
